name: Reference Based Color Transfer for Medical Volume Rendering
definition: A framework that performs color transfer by finding deep semantic correspondence between a colored reference image and a monochromatic target medical image (CT/MRI), followed by direct volume rendering of the colorized image stack to eliminate manual transfer function interaction.
summary: Reference Based Color Transfer automates medical volume colorization by mapping monochromatic data to semantically similar reference images, eliminating manual tuning and large training datasets.
